board.cSSCustomPropertiesAndA: CSS custom properties and a C++ header from one file.

board.notesBecomeReusableKnowledgeWith: Notes become reusable knowledge with backlinks.
board.oneAccentQuietChromeContent: One accent, quiet chrome, content first.
board.zonesNoteCardsABlock: Zones, note cards, a block and a connection, arranged to show the intended look. No engine, no data, nothing is draggable or saved.
colours.everySwatchReadsAGenerated: Every swatch reads a generated custom property from the design tokens. Translucent tokens are shown over --card so their effect is visible. No raw colour values appear in this preview.
components.bodyTextCanAlsoBe: Body text can also be muted.
components.captionToolbar: 48 px bar · 36 px buttons · 20 px icons
components.connectionsJoinRelatedNotesAc: Connections join related notes across zones.
components.groupsAreSeparatedByA: Groups are separated by a divider; only one filled accent tool appears at a time.
components.noInnerScrollbarTheBlock: No inner scrollbar — the block grows
components.oneExampleEachOfA: One example each of a note card, a block, a zone, a connection, a side-panel header and the toolbar arrangement. These are static markup, not engine objects.
components.panelTitleUsesTheSerif: Panel title uses the serif stack at 22 px; the status slot keeps a fixed height.
components.thePersonSContentIs: The person’s content is the brightest thing on screen; bars, frames and buttons step back.
components.theZoneHeaderNamesThe: The zone header names the group; content starts below the header.
contract.aD1EveryChangeTo: AD-1: every change to board content is one operation with exactly one inverse, and group is ordered and never nested.
contract.aDurableAckCoversEvery: A durable ack covers every operation id of its batch (AD-2); presence is ephemeral and carries no operations.
contract.clientToServerServerTo: client to server, server to client
contract.closedEnvelopesForTheFour: Closed envelopes for the four resources (workspace, board, note, card) and one error envelope; corpus fixtures-api/.
contract.codegenMjsDeterministicallyGene: codegen.mjs deterministically generated the committed generated/types.ts and generated/contract.h; hand edits fail the codegen gate on a diff, so the types cannot drift from the schemas.
contract.demoCadenceThisOverviewIs: Demo cadence: this overview is kept current in the same task as every contract or preview change, and the live two-note demo above stays permanently (docs/quality.md).
contract.everyFixtureInTheParity: Every fixture in the parity corpus is reduced to one canonical line by test/parity/canonical.ts; test/cpp/parity.cpp reads the same wrappers with generated/contract.h, and the unit suite asserts that the TypeScript and C++ line sets are identical — a tampered line is detected.
contract.everythingTheEngineTheBackend: Everything the engine, the backend and the web exchange is versioned JSON Schema in packages/contracts: board content, its operations with exactly one inverse each, the WebSocket sync protocol and the REST API resources and errors, with valid and invalid fixtures and generated TypeScript and C++. Version 0.1.0 is logical in this stage: the contracts@0.1.0 tag is created by the owner or CI in the remote phase (ADR-0002, ADR-0003). The $id base https://project-air.dev/contracts/0.1.0/ is a placeholder until the domain is decided (Q1).
contract.logicalTheTagWaitsFor: logical; the tag waits for the remote phase
contract.oneClosedOneOfEnvelopeFor: One closed oneOf envelope for the WebSocket messages; corpus fixtures-sync/.
contract.readTheFullContractIn: Read the full contract in docs/contracts.md and the decision in ADR-0005 — Contract and versions.
contract.stableWireCodesWithMessage: stable wire codes with message keys
contract.theCodegenInputSchemasAnd: The codegen input schemas and the root board-content.schema.json; corpus fixtures/.
contract.theWireCodeStaysLanguage: The wire code stays language-neutral; the required messageKey is errors.<camelCase>, so the user text comes from the translation files (AD-8).
contract.twoDirectPolierSpecimensCopy: Two direct Polier specimens copy the canonical board-content fixtures, because the Polier contracts gate only reads valid/*.json and invalid/*.json; a unit test enforces the copies.
demo.aClickWithoutMovementUnder: A click without movement (under 4 px) selects the card; the four side-midpoint anchors are invisible geometry and the edge snaps to the nearest pair. Toolbar, zone and zoom pill are preview-only: a tool click only selects it and changes nothing on the canvas.
demo.demoToolbarPreviewOnlySelecting: Demo toolbar, preview only: selecting a tool changes nothing on the canvas
demo.draggableNoteCardAArrow: Draggable note card A. Arrow keys move it by 16 pixels, Home resets both cards.
demo.draggableNoteCardBArrow: Draggable note card B. Arrow keys move it by 16 pixels, Home resets both cards.
demo.oneSourceForCSSAnd: One source for CSS and C++.
demo.ownerSuppliedDemoPhotoA: Owner-supplied demo photo: a lake shore with pine trees and boulders below snowy mountains.
demo.staticPreviewZoneWithA: Static preview zone with a notepad and an image window
demo.status.reset: Both cards returned to their start positions.
demo.status.tool: Tool {label} selected. Preview only: no canvas action.
demo.theInteractiveDemoNeedsJavaScript: The interactive demo needs JavaScript. The rest of this page is static and works without it.
demo.toolbarPreviewOnlyZoneNotepad: toolbar · preview-only · zone · notepad + image window · curve · --tone-d · 1.5 px
demo.twoNoteCardsAndOne: Two note cards and one connection, plus a preview-only toolbar and a static zone. Drag a card with mouse, pen or finger — the whole card is the handle — or focus a card and use the arrow keys (16 px per step, Home resets both). interactive demo — not the engine; no data, no server.
footer.colourSpacingRadiusTypographyMoti: Colour, spacing, radius, typography, motion, shadow and layer values come only from packages/ui-kit/tokens.css; icons come from packages/ui-kit/icons/. Both are linked relatively and served from the repository root.
footer.thisIsAStaticDesign: This is a static design preview, not the product. It has no engine, no data, no server and no build step; it exists so the design system can be reviewed between milestones. The connection demo is a pointer-event sketch, not the engine.
icons.theTenIconsShipAs: The ten icons ship as SVG files in packages/ui-kit/icons/, drawn on a 24 grid with a 1.6 stroke and currentColor. Each tile shows the 20 px icon in a 36 px bar button and the 16 px icon in a 28 px card button; the file is loaded directly by this page.
masthead.aStaticDesignPreviewOf: A static design preview of the Project air canvas design system: tokens, type, icons, component states, the contract 0.1.0 overview and a sample board, plus a small live connection demo with a preview-only toolbar and a zone. This page is not the product — there is no engine, no data and no server; the demo at the top is illustrative only.
masthead.lastChange: Last change: P0-27 — Bilingual preview with DE/EN switch and cache-busted assets
page.projectAirDesignPreviewStatic: Project air design preview — static design preview
space.a4PxGrid4: A 4 px grid: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 and 48. Radii are 10, 14, 20, a 6 px tooltip radius and a pill; surfaces use the two token shadows only.
space.headerHeaderHeight40Px: Header --header-height 40 px · click target --click-target 32 px · bar button --button-bar 36 px · toolbar icon --icon-bar 20 px · card action --button-card 28 px · card icon --icon-card 16 px · canvas grid --canvas-grid 16 px.
states.everyInteractiveElementHasRest: Every interactive element has rest, hover, pressed, keyboard focus and disabled; cards and blocks also have selected. The samples below show each state side by side; the buttons are real buttons, so native hover, press and focus work too.
states.focusIsA2Px: Focus is a 2 px --accent outline with 2 px offset; pressed adds scale(0.97); disabled is opacity 0.4 without hover.
states.text15PxAccentBorder: 1.5 px --accent border with a 3 px --accent-soft ring.
states.text1PxBorderStrongBorder: 1 px --border-strong border with --card-shadow; the card action is invisible until hover or focus.
type.bodyTextInCardsAnd: Body text in cards and blocks. Content is the brightest thing on screen; bars and buttons step back.
type.serifForBoardPanelAnd: Serif for board, panel and empty-state titles, sans for everything else. Sizes come from --text-28 to --text-11; weights are regular, medium and semibold. No font files are loaded — the token stacks fall back to locally installed fonts.
type.statusAndHintsForExample: Status and hints, for example “Saved” or “Saving …”.
